fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of inline Python code via the "-c" in order to call the "system" function from the "os" library, and spawn a shell.
fields.name: Inline Python Execution - Spawn Shell Via OS System Library
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "/python" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/python2" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/python3") or (tgt.process.image.path contains "/python2." or tgt.process.image.path contains "/python3.")) and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains " -c " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "os.system(") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/bash" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/dash" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/fish" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/sh" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/zsh"))))
